item.title: NCSC urges UK organisations to patch ExampleVPN gateways (CVE-2026-10001)
item.description: The NCSC is aware of active exploitation of CVE-2026-10001 in ExampleVPN affecting UK organisations. Attackers use T1190 then T1078.

item.title: Joint advisory: state-sponsored actor targets UK telecoms
item.description: A China-linked APT group is targeting UK and Five Eyes telecom carriers. C2 at 203.0.113.45 and update-check[.]example.com.
